subject: Private patch review: scheduling, telemetry gates, and rollback tokens
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Huang <alice.huang@acmehealth.com>, support@rackscale.io
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private patch review: scheduling, telemetry gates, and rollback tokens

Hi Alice / RackScale team —

Quick note to start a short planning thread for the Oct/Nov private instance patch we've discussed. Goal: agree on a maintenance date range, telemetry gating thresholds for canary release, and rollback token custody. High level ask: can we run a 24-hour canary in your staging VPC, then a 4-hour production window with progressive node churn?

Proposed cadence (suggestions, not final):
- Oct 20-22: staging canary (24h steady state after patch)
- Oct 25, 01:00–05:00 UTC: prod maintenance window (4h, low-traffic period)
- Rollback plan: instant flag to pin previous model + KV cache invalidation and cluster scale-down then restart; will need RackScale to hold the cluster snapshot from node 0 and 1 for fast rollback.

Telemetry/acceptance gates (examples):
- 99th pct latency increase <= 15% vs baseline
- 5xx errors increase <= 0.1% absolute
- Inference p95 tail latency CPU/GPU imbalance detection (alert if > 2x)

Attachments: a draft preflight checklist and a canary rollforward script attached. Please review and call out any missing gating metrics you want observed (DB reconnects, KMS latency, audit log gaps, etc.).

Next steps: Alice, can you confirm whether Oct 25 window works for your operations? RackScale, can you confirm availability to snapshot nodes and hold rollback artifacts? Dev/Laura — please add any infra gating requirements.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0199

--
Attachments: private-patch-preflight-checklist.pdf (24 KB), canary-rollforward-script.sh (4 KB)

From: Alice Huang <alice.huang@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, support@rackscale.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private patch review: scheduling, telemetry gates, and rollback tokens

Thanks Jasmine — that schedule is reasonable on our side. A couple of quick notes from ops: 
- Oct 25 window is fine but prefer start at 00:30 UTC to avoid overlap with our nightly backups (we can shift if needed).
- We need RackScale to retain an LVM snapshot and etag for our NFS mounts for 72 hours post-patch.
- We'll require a read-only mode toggle for the user-facing API during the 15-minute cutover — can you confirm Redwood supports that toggle via control plane?

Also we want a short, customer-facing blurb for our status page we can publish during the window. Happy to draft once you confirm the gating messages.

Alice
Director of Platform Ops | Acme Health
alice.huang@acmehealth.com
+1 617-555-1212

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Huang <alice.huang@acmehealth.com>, support@rackscale.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private patch review: scheduling, telemetry gates, and rollback tokens

Adding the infra checklist and a few implementation notes below. Quoted earlier for continuity.

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu wrote:
> Proposed cadence (suggestions, not final):
> - Oct 20-22: staging canary (24h steady state after patch)
> - Oct 25, 01:00–05:00 UTC: prod maintenance window (4h, low-traffic period)

Implementation notes / gating details from the runtime side:
- Version pinning: we'll publish a version manifest and a pin-token. During the window, control-plane will allow pin/unpin via API only from RBAC users in the "Acme-admins" group. We'll hand over a single-use rollback token (HMAC) to your SREs for immediate reversion.
- KV cache invalidation: recommend chunked invalidation to avoid thundering herd — we'll run a 10s rolling invalidation across nodes.
- Telemetry hooks: please ingest our trace span with header x-rdw-canary=true; we will export spans to your OTLP endpoint. We need your OTLP collector endpoint and a short retention window (48h) for traces from canary.
- DB migration gating: no DB schema changes in this release. If any migration is required, schedule a separate outage.

Preflight automation we will run (attached):
1) Health-check sweep (all processes + GPU drivers)
2) Disk/iops smoke test (10m)
3) KMS handshake latency (3x)
4) Rolling inference on synthetic prompts with baseline score comparison

If those pass, canary will go live. If telemetry crosses any threshold, the control-plane will auto-initiate rollback (configurable: auto vs manual). Our default is manual rollback with a 15-minute grace period.

Let us know your OTLP endpoint and whether you prefer auto or manual rollback as default. Also confirming we will supply the LVM snapshot job for RackScale to hold.

- Dev

--
Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Runtime | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Huang <alice.huang@acmehealth.com>, support@rackscale.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private patch review: scheduling, telemetry gates, and rollback tokens

Thanks all — summarizing decisions and outstanding action items so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions: 
- Staging canary: Oct 20-22 (24h steady state)
- Prod window: Oct 25, 00:30–04:30 UTC (per Alice request)
- Rollback custody: RackScale will snapshot nodes 0/1 and hold LVM snapshot for 72h. Redwood will provide single-use HMAC rollback token to Acme SREs.
- Default rollback mode: MANUAL with 15-minute grace auto-trigger (auto only if explicitly enabled by Acme).

Outstanding action items: 
- Alice: provide OTLP endpoint and confirm read-only toggle is acceptable for customer UX blip.
- RackScale (support@rackscale.io): confirm snapshot retention and provide snapshot-etag and snapshot-access playbook.
- Dev/Redwood: finalize preflight checklist (attached) and publish version-manifest prior to Oct 18.
- Laura: draft the customer-facing status blurb and share for review by Oct 12.

I attached the current preflight checklist and a canonical canary rollback script. I'm scheduling a 30-minute sync on Oct 13 (invite to follow) to walk through the rollback runbook and telemetry dashboards. If anyone prefers a different cadence for the sync, reply with availability.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
